h1: How do building inspections work in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Building Inspections: Scheduling and What Is Checked
description: How to schedule a Newton building inspection, the call-before-8-AM rule, and what must be ready at each stage from excavation to final.
short_answer: The permit holder arranges every inspection. For building inspections, call before 8 AM on the day the work is ready, and the inspector calls back by 9:30 AM to schedule it. Electrical and plumbing/gas inspections are scheduled in advance, and the final building inspection comes last.

facts.text: The permit holder must arrange all inspections.
Building inspections are same-day when the job is complete and ready.
Call before 8 AM on the desired day, and leave a voicemail if no one answers. The inspector calls back by 9:30 AM to schedule.
Electrical and plumbing/gas inspections are scheduled in advance.

sections.heading: What must be ready at each stage

facts.text: Excavation: inspected at the bottom of the hole, before footings or crushed stone.
Footings: forms stripped before the wall is poured. Deck footings are inspected before pouring.
Before backfill: foundation poured and coated if required. An as-built may be requested.
Rough: building weather-tight with roof, windows and doors installed and siding 75% complete. Rough plumbing, electrical and HVAC inspections done first, and all firestopping complete.
Insulation: insulation and vapor barrier installed, and a mid-point HERS rating uploaded to the portal.
Final: last, after all other inspections pass.

qa.q: How do I schedule a building inspection in Newton?
qa.a: Call before 8 AM on the day you want it. Leave a voicemail if no one answers, and the inspector calls back by 9:30 AM.

qa.q: What is needed for a rough inspection?
qa.a: A weather-tight building with roof, windows and doors installed, siding 75% complete, rough trade inspections passed, and firestopping complete.

qa.q: What is needed for an insulation inspection?
qa.a: Completed insulation, an installed vapor barrier, and a mid-point HERS rating uploaded to the portal.
Last, after all other inspections pass.
